security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; media-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: A garden you tend, a friend you raise.
bundle.longDescription: GLADE is a calm, offline-first sanctuary game — a spiritual successor to the Chao Garden. Raise a Bloomling from a seed-egg through patient daily care, feed it light or moonlight to shape who it becomes, and tend the living garden that grows up around it. Nothing here can hurt you; the thing you love will remember you.
